strings.zh: 石英大会是所有训练家们的盛会,{NEWLINE}为了庆祝这场盛会召开,{CLEAR}我特意练习了几首歌,你要听听吗？
strings.en: The Indigo Conference is a grand{NEWLINE}festival for every Trainer.{SCROLL}To celebrate, I practiced a few songs.{NEWLINE}Want to hear them?

strings.zh: 我还练习了其他歌曲,{NEWLINE}你还要听听吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I practiced some other songs too. Want{NEWLINE}to hear more?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 怎么样,这些歌有没有{NEWLINE}勾起你的什么回忆呢？
strings.en: Well? Did these songs bring back any{NEWLINE}memories?
